name: remote-focus-forgets-sessions-silent-for-thirty-minutes
description: Cycle Session Focus steps only through remote sessions seen in the last 30 minutes. A session silent for longer is forgotten, so the focus goes straight to the session still active, then back to all sessions.
reason: Sessions end without telling PowerUp (a closed terminal sends no SessionEnd). Keeping them forever would fill the focus cycle with sessions that no longer exist, each muting the live ones.

script.reason: Session alpha shows up, then goes silent.
Alpha's turn expires on the way; the session itself is still remembered.
Session beta shows up 1000 seconds later.
Alpha has now been silent for 1801 seconds, just past 30 minutes; beta for 801.
Alpha is forgotten, so the first session in the cycle is beta.
Past the last session the focus wraps to all.

transcript.text: Focus → beta — only this session is spoken now.
